item.name: Cheese_Serving_Trays
item.description: Food-service trays that hold sealed ice below the serving grids and mats.
item.readyBeforeUse: Trays are clean, sanitized, air-dry, and have no crack or leak.
item.readyForNextPerson: During service, trays are leak-free and keep food at or below 41°F. After service, they are washed, rinsed, sanitized, air-dry, and stored.
item.ifNotReady: Do not use a cracked or leaking tray. Tell the Food Lead.
